runners.comment: More exposed than most but sets the standard and a leading contender.
runners.name: Escortkheops
runners.spotlight: Shaped promisingly when ridden with more restraint and finishing runner-up back at a similar trip at Southwell last month; more exposed than most but sets the standard with a mark of 110 and a leading contender with no ground concerns.

runners.comment: Pulled up on January's hurdle debut, but it's still early days for respected connections.
runners.name: Idaho Fire
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on sole start in a point (2m5f, good) last March; showed some promise on rules/stable debut in an October bumper, but pulled up switched to hurdles at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) in January, reportedly hanging right, still early days for respected connections.

runners.comment: Faced a stiff task on hurdle debut but this is easier and the longer trip should suit.
runners.name: Lunar Morning
runners.spotlight: May have made the frame but for a late fall in a 3m Irish point one year ago, and faced a stiff task when pulled up behind some useful opposition on October's hurdle debut at Uttoxeter (2m, good); off since but faces a much easier here now up in trip with cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Bled from the nose latest but respected on his earlier Stratford third (2m, good to soft)
runners.name: Our Amigo
runners.owner: Mrs H Allan & Mrs L Meagher
runners.spotlight: Well-related Malinas gelding who has shown promise in a point and over hurdles; bled from the nose when finishing a well-held fifth at Lingfield in November but an earlier Stratford third (2m, good to soft) reads well; worth considering with the longer trip expected to suit.

runners.comment: Yet to fire over hurdles but the step up in trip and less testing ground could help.
runners.name: West Along
runners.spotlight: Placed in an Irish point; dead-heated for second on bumper debut at Fontwell (good to soft) on Boxing Day, but well held on both hurdle starts on heavy since, latest when a 37l third there last month; takes another step up in trip and less testing ground may help.

runners.comment: Yet to show any worthwhile form and needs to take a big step forward now up in trip.
runners.name: Approaching Storm
runners.spotlight: Well held in both bumpers and fared no better when tailed off on last month's switch hurdle debut; goes up in trip but big improvement needed.

runners.comment: Made a satisfactory start to her hurdle career but will need to build on that to figure.
runners.name: Lola De Magny
runners.spotlight: £30,000 purchase after winning her fourth start in Irish points; made a satisfactory start to her hurdle career when a 30l fourth over C&D in January; she'll need to build on that to trouble a couple of these.

runners.comment: Point winner; promising on bumper debut; hurdles debut for leading stable; trip can suit
runners.name: Viscountess Nelson
runners.owner: Old Gold Racing With Francesca Cumani
runners.spotlight: £40,000 buy after landing an Irish mares' maiden point on debut last April and shaped with promise when a 6.5l fourth in a Huntingdon bumper (good to soft) in December; of obvious interest for her leading stable on this switch to hurdles with the step up in trip expected to suit.

14:45.race_name: Southern Cranes & Access Ltd Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Three hurdle wins at up to 2m3f; 0-5 over fences but promising chase run in December
runners.name: Park Annonciade
runners.spotlight: Three hurdle wins at up to 2m3f (all on good to soft; acts on good); 0-5 over fences but, after two moderate hurdle runs for new yard, he ran much better when close up in a Ludlow chase (2m, good to soft) in December; on a handy mark now and could be interesting.

runners.breeder: E A R L Elevage Des Loges
runners.comment: Has won on a range of surfaces; front-runs; 5lb higher than latest win; can go well fresh
runners.name: Delpotro
runners.spotlight: Won on heavy and soft in France but kept to good or quicker in Britain; front-runner who has a good record at Sedgefield, winning twice there in 2025 (2m and 2m3f); still 5lb higher than the latest of them in October but he can go well fresh so not ruled out back from a break.

runners.comment: All 5 wins on this track; back to form last month but soundly beaten here since
runners.name: Alto Alto
runners.spotlight: All five wins on this track, over hurdles and fences (good and soft); ran his best race for a while over C&D last month, but soundly beaten when last of four finishers (odds-on) here since; reservations now.

runners.comment: Two near-misses in Irish points; bumper winner; first hurdle win here latest; chase debut
runners.name: Kool Kid
runners.spotlight: Two near-misses in Irish points but he found plenty when winning a Hereford bumper on yard debut; mixed fortunes over hurdles but he was a convincing winner of his third handicap, here (2m, soft) latest, more so than the 1.5l winning distance suggests; up 5lb; obvious potential on chase debut.

runners.comment: Below best since Lingfield win (2m, soft) in late 2024; pulled up latest; has it to prove
runners.name: Angels Dream
runners.spotlight: Won on first completion over fences, at Lingfield (2m, soft) in November 2024, but he hasn't run to the same level since, pulling up at Fontwell (first-time cheekpieces, retained) in January on second run back from an absence; has it to prove at present.

15:15.race_name: William Henry Robinson Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Earned RPR of 99 when runner-up at Fakenham (2m) latest; key role to play in a weak race.
runners.name: Risk It All
runners.owner: Keith F J Loads & Harry Redknapp
runners.spotlight: Beaten at short odds (well clear at one point) over C&D in January 2025; has fared better since, earning an RPR of 99 when runner-up at Fakenham (2m, soft; 4-1) latest; this lacks strength in depth, so he should have key role to play.

runners.comment: Beaten neck over C&D (25-1) penultimate start; failed to back it up since; cheekpieces on.
runners.name: Kill The Groove
runners.owner: D Hill N Emanuel & B Chantler
runners.spotlight: Kept a stablemate of Risk It All right up to his work when beaten a neck over C&D (25-1) on penultimate start; failed to back it up (fourth, beaten over 14l) next time; cheekpieces are added as she seeks to make it tenth-time lucky.

runners.comment: Beaten 24l, 50l, & 49l respectively in three attempts over hurdles; easy to look elsewhere
runners.name: Major Major
runners.spotlight: Three Flat wins (1m2f-11.5f); beaten 24l, 50l, and 49l respectively in three attempts over hurdles; switches to a novice handicap but it is easy to look elsewhere.

runners.comment: Third when last in action at Cartmel (2m1f, good; beaten under 10l) last July; easing mark
runners.name: Kingston Bresil
runners.spotlight: Shaped okay at massive odds (never-nearer third, 150-1) on last visit to Plumpton in December 2024; occupied same position when last in action at Cartmel (2m1f, good; beaten under 10l) last July; easing mark, with Charlie Maggs taking over in saddle.

runners.comment: Remote third in C&D maiden (soft; 100-1) three weeks ago; cheekpieces on; handicap debut
runners.name: My Lovely Horse
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in two of her four attempts over hurdles; remote third in C&D maiden (soft; 100-1) three weeks ago; sports newly applied cheekpieces for handicap debut.

runners.comment: Tailed off all three starts over hurdles, the latest in C&D maiden (250-1) last November.
runners.name: Foinix
runners.owner: M Robinson Jack Pook & Jeanette May
runners.spotlight: Modest Flat handicapper; tailed off all three starts over hurdles, the latest in a C&D maiden (good; 250-1) last November; only eighth of ten at Southwell (1m3f AW) in January; handicap hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Not massive amount to take from first three starts; may fare better now handicapping
runners.name: Jacquetta
runners.spotlight: Not a massive amount to take from three starts, although it was a competitive novice he contested at Newbury (2m, beaten 45l; 200-1) in January; pulled up at Lingfield (2m4f, heavy) latest; handicap debut; stablemate of Risk It All.

runners.comment: Unseated rider when last over hurdles (0-5); near miss on Flat at Lingfield (1m4f) latest.
runners.name: Charles Morin
runners.spotlight: No impression when unseating at the last at Kempton (2m novice handicap, good; 28-1) last April; campaigned exclusively on the Flat since, with form figures of 42342, and losing out by only a head at Lingfield (1m4f; 17-2) three weeks ago; a possible back hurdling.

runners.breeder: Haras De S A Aga Khan Scea
runners.comment: French Flat winner; well beaten in four hurdle runs for new yard; handicap debut
runners.name: Somkiyr
runners.spotlight: Flat winner in France (8.5f) in October 2023; well beaten in four attempts over hurdles since joining this trainer; improvement required on handicap debut.

15:45.race_name: Southern Cranes & Access Ltd Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: All wins over further but there can be hope she'll be effective at this trip; in the mix.
runners.name: Al Sayah
runners.spotlight: Four-time hurdle winner (2m3f-2m5f); ran respectably from this mark when fourth at Newton Abbot in October; has run well on the back of a break in the past and there can be hope she will be equally effective at this trip; could make her presence felt.

runners.comment: Worth considering after a better effort latest now back in trip and eased in the weights.
runners.name: Dramatic Encore
runners.spotlight: Yet to build on her Huntingdon maiden hurdle win last February but she's gone close since; returned to some form when a 12l fourth at this level at Ludlow (2m5f, soft) last month, running without her usual tongue-tie but fitted with first-time cheekpieces; drops in trip here and eased in the weights, so worth considering.

runners.comment: Yet to replicate her useful bumper form but improved for wind surgery latest; player.
runners.name: La Marquise
runners.spotlight: Dual soft-ground bumper winner who finished third in an Aintree Grade 2 in April 2024; yet to replicate that level over hurdles, but she showed marked improvement after wind surgery when a 5.75l third at Wetherby (2m3f, soft) 18 days ago, following a break; likely to build on that and, with Joe Anderson's useful 3lb claim, she looks set for a big run.

runners.comment: Far too free here latest, but can fare better now back in trip and on quicker ground.
runners.name: A Tickatickatiming
runners.spotlight: Bumper and 2m hurdle (good to soft) winner here in 2023 and, although winless since in limited appearances, has posted some solid placed efforts; had excuses when tailed off here latest, too free and failed to stay 2m4f; likely to fare better now returning to a shorter trip and quicker ground.

runners.comment: On a tough mark but a three-time hurdle winner and may improve for this switch to fences.
runners.name: Ferret Jeeter
runners.spotlight: 3-9 over hurdles, the wins at 2m5f-3m1f (one here), and recent effort off this mark under Chad Bament when second around here was solid; probably on a stiff enough mark, but appeals as the type to improve for fences and a bold showing can be expected on chase debut.

runners.comment: Four-time chase winner who came back to form at Wincanton last month; respected.
runners.name: West Orchard
runners.spotlight: Four-time chase winner (2m3f/3m1f) in 2023 and 2024, two of them here, and shaped promisingly on hurdles return in December after a long absence; left behind a below-par run over fences later that month with a short-head defeat at Wincanton (3m1f, good to soft) last month; back up 2lb but needs respecting with course form.

runners.comment: 11-race maiden but on a workable mark, particularly if tongue-tie/cheekpieces are a plus.
runners.name: Inedit De Mee
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden with six of those coming over fences; mark continues to slide and he has the odd bit of form that suggests he could be competitive, particularly if the tongue-tie/cheekpieces prove a positive addition.

runners.breeder: Haras De Saint Voir Sca & Mr Joel Denis
runners.comment: Back to form on his last three runs and holds place claims again off an unchanged mark.
runners.name: Illogical Logic
runners.spotlight: Back in form since pulling up twice earlier in the season, reaching the frame on his last three starts, most recently at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) in January when third of seven, beaten just under 6l; place claims off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Needs the return to better ground to spark a revival after some lesser efforts of late.
runners.name: School For Scandal
runners.owner: K Johns & Joe Tickle Racing Club
runners.spotlight: 2lb below his Windsor success in November but he's not matched that level since, latest when well held at Taunton (2m7f, heavy) last month; needs the return to better ground to spark a revival.

runners.comment: Back to form when winning at Huntingdon last time and she's respected off 5lb higher.
runners.name: Imperial Pride
runners.spotlight: Out of sorts initially this season but she wasn't without her supporters when back to form and winning at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to soft) two weeks ago, and the 5lb rise looks manageable in her follow-up bid; leading contender if in the same frame of mind.

runners.breeder: C A F R E Enniskellen Campus
runners.comment: Lacks consistency but may have doubled her score but for unseating at the last in October.
runners.name: Ballygelly
runners.spotlight: Won a match at Fakenham in April last year and would possibly have doubled her score back at that venue but for unseating at the last in October, returns from another break and hard to be confident she'd repeat the effort.

runners.breeder: A OBrienM Al Monsour& K Al Attiyah
runners.comment: Close on first start for trainer at Worcester (2m4f) last September; less effective since.
runners.name: Ghasham
runners.spotlight: Sole hurdles win was for Ian Williams at Market Rasen (2m4f) three years ago; went close on first start for this trainer at Worcester (2m4f) last September; trip possibly short enough at Market Rasen and Sedgefield post wind surgery; easing mark and claimer ridden.

runners.comment: Veteran; without win since December 2024; tough to draw inspiration from last two efforts.
runners.name: Bread And Butter
runners.spotlight: Veteran; no win since December 2024 when beating Ghasham by 1.5l at Huntingdon (2m4f); much lower in the weights now but it is difficult to draw inspiration from either of his last two efforts; far better to focus elsewhere.

runners.comment: Resumed winning ways at Taunton (2m3f; 5-1) last week; on premises if in the same form
runners.name: Taritino
runners.spotlight: Kept on well to resume winning ways at Taunton (2m3f, good; 5-1) last week; competes from the same mark (no penalty) here, so must enter calculations even if he's shown the bulk of his best form at that West country venue; on the premises if in the same form.

runners.comment: Made all to notch third C&D win (soft; from 7lb lower) three weeks ago; one of likeliest.
runners.name: Eliza Dolittle
runners.spotlight: Made all to notch her third C&D win (soft; from 7lb lower) three weeks ago; that was in a mares' contest but she was a comfortable winner and this track brings out the best in her; one of the likeliest candidates.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Des Mottes
runners.comment: 3m1f winner here (soft) last month; twice beaten at odds-on since (worn down on Saturday).
runners.name: Junior Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Won two of his first three for this trainer, including when comfortably winning over 3m1f here (soft; from 9lb lower); fluffed lines on good ground at Catterick (third, 5-6 favourite) subsequently, and worn down late at Fontwell (8-11 favourite) on Saturday.

runners.breeder: P Mehat & B Mehat & C Lemeunier
runners.comment: Poor for Christian Williams (0-8), toiling in cheekpeices at Ffos Las (2m4f, soft) latest.
runners.name: Kap De Triomphe
runners.spotlight: Irish bumper winner; has proved disappointing for Christian Williams, including when well beaten in new cheekpieces at Ffos Las (2m4f, soft; 28-1) last November; now on 3lb career-low mark off  a 117-day absence.

runners.comment: Better on handicap debut here (2m; sixth) seven weeks ago; stamina questionable over 2m4f.
runners.name: Ephyra
runners.spotlight: Placed on Flat (2m AW) for David Menuisier but failed to figure on first three attempts over hurdles; better, only weakening from the last, when sixth of seven on handicap debut here (2m, soft; 10-1) seven weeks ago; stamina questionable over 2m4f.

17:15.race_name: Hop On Down To The Easter Festival Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Irish point winner who showed considerable promise on both runs in bumpers; big chance.
runners.name: Double The Dance
runners.spotlight: 100,00euros buy following an Irish point win in April; has displayed considerable promise in finishing runner-up on both bumpers runs, latest at Fontwell (2m1f, good to soft) on Boxing Day; leading contender.

runners.comment: Made a promising debut over C&D in December but not so good latest; could bounce back.
runners.name: Soldier Poet
runners.spotlight: Made a promising debut when a close second over C&D (soft) in December, but subsequent Warwick run was disappointing; needs to leave that effort behind but a return to this venue may help.

runners.comment: Nicely bred mare from a leading stable and one to watch in the betting on debut.
runners.name: Getmyfriend
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to winners Parvos (2m1f hurdle) and Lau And Shaz (1m7f/2m hurdle); dam unraced half-sister to high-class bumper and 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Simonsig and smart 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Dysart; nicely bred mare who represents a leading stable and has to be of interest.

runners.comment: Likeable pedigree and worth considering on debut; respected stable.
runners.name: Luna Marquesa
runners.spotlight: 85,000euros purchase in June; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Halibut (2m hurdle) and Jubilant (bumper and 2m7f-3m2f hurdle/chase); dam a half-sister to high-class chaser Editeur Du Gite; likeable pedigree and one to watch in the market on debut; respected stable.

runners.comment: Has found only one too good on both bumper runs; sets a fair standard; high on the list.
runners.name: Secret Des Lune
runners.spotlight: Has found only one too good on both starts in bumpers (good to soft/ heavy), including over C&D on debut; sets a fair standard and likely to be in the mix returned to better ground.

14:30.race_name: Plan A Conditional Jockeys' Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Clear course winner in November but returned from break with two lesser runs in February
runners.name: Hellfire Princess
runners.spotlight: Posted career-best performance when coming from off the pace to score by 6l here (2m6f, soft) in November but returned from break with two lesser efforts last month (2m5f/3m1f) and now has a point to prove; usual cheekpieces (left off last time) back on today.

runners.comment: Unexposed 5yo who was going okay before unseating rider on recent handicap debut
runners.name: Man Maid
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 5yo who was in touch and still travelling okay when unseating rider at third-last flight on recent handicap debut at Wincanton (1m7f, good to soft); moves up in trip here; very hard to rule out.

runners.comment: Stayed on well for Leicester win in January and ran big race in defeat last month
runners.name: Queen Of Steel
runners.spotlight: Stayed on gamely to score at Leicester (2m4f, heavy) in January, her third hurdle win, and probably bettered that performance when close/clear second at Southwell (3m, soft) last month; competes off career-high mark here but still respected in current form.

runners.comment: Close up in first two handicaps, both over 2m3f at Chepstow (soft) this year; respected
runners.name: Rest Is The Best
runners.spotlight: Close up in first two handicaps, both over 2m3f at Chepstow (soft) this year; beaten under 1l after finishing well in first-time cheekpieces on latter occasion and has obvious claims if in similar form here.

runners.comment: Ran quite well on handicap debut (2m) and subsequent 2m3f defeat is not viewed harshly
runners.name: Neeps And Tatties
runners.owner: Dalziel Family K Rogers D Vowles
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo who made quite encouraging handicap debut when fourth at Huntingdon (2m, heavy) last month; didn't build on that effort at Hereford (2m3f, good) nine days ago but a mid-race jumping error seemed to knock her out of her rhythm there, and she remains open to improvement over this sort of trip now she's back on slower ground.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten in both handicaps and difficult to enthuse over
runners.name: Half Pint Daisy
runners.spotlight: Struggled to get competitive when 50-1 for handicap debut in January and finished about 16l behind Rest Is The Best when never-dangerous sixth at Chepstow (2m3f, soft) last month; difficult to enthuse over.

15:00.race_name: Good Luck Barry Murphy Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Unseated rider when returned to chasing in January and has suffered a heavy defeat since
runners.name: Walkinthewoods
runners.spotlight: Unseated rider when returned to chasing in January and has suffered a heavy defeat since; on a workable mark and suited by this C&D/slow ground but has some questions to answer.

runners.comment: Needs to rebound from a poor run but was placed here on first two starts this season
runners.name: Boston Joe
runners.spotlight: Gained three of his five chase wins here; must bounce back from a poor performance (over hurdles) in January but was placed here on first two starts this season (2m4f hurdle/2m chase) and has been given a chance by the handicapper.

runners.comment: Good second over C&D on chase debut but pulled up since and now 0-14 under rules
runners.name: Benignitas
runners.spotlight: Clear second in C&D mares' race (heavy ground) on chasing debut in January and has claims if judged on that performance but was pulled up at Hereford last month and is now 0-14 under rules; others preferred.

runners.comment: Began year with three slow-ground wins and lost out only narrowly last time; good chance
runners.name: El Rojo Grande
runners.owner: Genghis Racing & Mike Harris Racing Club
runners.spotlight: Began this year with three slow-ground wins (2m-2m1f, one here) and lost out only by a head when second here (2m, heavy; front pair well clear) on latest outing; continues to climb up the weights but should be fine over today's longer trip and can make his presence felt again.

runners.comment: Not really firing on all cylinders towards end of last year; back from three-month break
runners.name: Henry Box Brown
runners.spotlight: Seemingly aided by addition of cheekpieces when making the frame three consecutive times (2m7f-3m) towards end of last year but still wasn't really firing on all cylinders; should be fine over this shorter trip but the headgear is missing today and he needs to have been refreshed by his three-month break.

runners.comment: Not bred for fences but was creditable second on recent chasing debut at Bangor
runners.name: Port Or Starboard
runners.spotlight: Not bred for fences and has very modest strike-rate on the Flat/over hurdles but was creditable second on recent chasing debut at Bangor (2m1f, soft) and remains very well handicapped on older hurdling form.

runners.comment: Still very unexposed but absent since falling on chase/handicap debut in September
runners.name: Ferando
runners.spotlight: Very unexposed after only four runs but was safely held in fifth before last-fence fall on chase/handicap debut at Sedgefield (2m5f, good) in September and has not raced since; now with a new stable (was with Alison Thorpe).

runners.comment: Well beaten in Grade 2 last month but had shown useful form beforehand; leading contender
runners.name: Lon Chaney
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten when upped to Grade 2 level last month (race in which Whiskey Yankee finished fifth) but had shown useful form beforehand, notably when winning by over 8l at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good to soft) two starts ago; can cope with this drop back in trip and has a big role to play.

runners.comment: Won on hurdle debut at Ascot (2m5f) and not disgraced in 3m Grade 2 since
runners.name: Whiskey Yankee
runners.spotlight: Showed that stamina is his strong suit on hurdling debut at Ascot (2m5f, soft) in January, battling on well to win by over 2l, and fared much better than Lon Chaney when fifth in Haydock Grade 2 (3m, good to soft) last month, despite a sketchy round of jumping; obvious contender.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten here on both hurdling starts; now with new stable
runners.name: Makinbecon
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two Irish points last spring but soundly beaten in two maiden hurdles here (2m/2m4f) for John and Rhys Flint this year and can only be watched on this stable debut.

runners.comment: Not disgraced when third of four over C&D on rules debut but needs improvement today
runners.name: Soldier For Glory
runners.spotlight: Certainly not disgraced when well-held third of four over C&D (heavy) on last month's rules debut but needs to take a big step forward to trouble the principals today.

16:00.race_name: Sarnau Stables Joins Barry Murphy Racing "Welsh Gold Cup" Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Returned from mammoth absence with low-key stable debut last month; hard to weigh up
runners.name: Loughderg Rocco
runners.spotlight: Made very promising start to chasing career for Laura Morgan in 2022 but, following a mammoth absence, struggled to get competitive (albeit in a good race) on last month's stable debut; sports refitted cheekpieces here; current ability very hard to gauge.

runners.breeder: Mme Henri Devin & Mme Victoria Devin
runners.comment: Ended 2025 with two below-par hurdle runs and last month's chase return was underwhelming
runners.name: Saint Palais
runners.spotlight: 4-7 over fences but ended 2025 with two disappointing hurdle runs and made very underwhelming return to chasing when seventh of eight at Newbury (2m7f, soft) in February; needs to turn things around.

runners.comment: Not disgraced in valuable races on last two outings; respected in these calmer waters
runners.name: Fortunate Man
runners.spotlight: Resumed last season's progress when winning on reappearance outing at Aintree (3m1f, good to soft) on Boxing Day and didn't run badly in valuable races on next two outings, more recently when fifth in 4m1f Eider at Newcastle last month; back in calmer waters here and may yet have more to offer.

runners.comment: Dual 2m4f chase winner; well held in 3m hurdle last time but still considered
runners.name: Big City Roller
runners.spotlight: 2-3 over fences, with both wins gained in four-runner 2m4f races on heavy ground; tailed off in a 3m hurdle last time but could quite plausibly have untapped potential over 3m as a chaser.

runners.comment: Didn't fire last time but a big player if judged on earlier Wincanton win; upped in trip
runners.name: Alfies Princess
runners.spotlight: Needs to rebound from a disappointing run in January but returned from long absence with emphatic success at Wincanton (2m4f, good to soft) on Boxing Day; remains lightly raced and is a big player if back on song for this first attempt at about 3m under rules.

runners.comment: 33-1 second here for another yard in January but far too inconsistent to rely upon
runners.name: Karuma Grey
runners.spotlight: Seemingly back in good form when 33-1 second over C&D (heavy; first-time cheekpieces) in January but failed to complete his next two races for Debra Hamer (latest was over hurdles); far too inconsistent to rely upon; headgear left off today on debut for new yard.

runners.comment: Small-field course winner in October but ended 2025 with two lesser runs; back from break
runners.name: Puddlesinthepark
runners.spotlight: Readily beat a stablemate in small-field marathon here (3m4f, good) in October and will be fine on today's slower ground but his two runs towards the end of last year were disappointing and he needs to have been refreshed by 101-day break.

runners.comment: Second to progressive rival at Chepstow last time and still has low mileage; likely player
runners.name: Genietoile
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 8yo who fell at first fence on penultimate outing but was placed in other two chases this season, more recently when second of 16 behind progressive rival at Chepstow (2m7f, soft; refitted tongue-tie) in January; up in grade here but still a likely contender.

runners.comment: In good form over hurdles this year and ran big race when back over fences last month
runners.name: Face dMusic
runners.spotlight: In good form over hurdles since swapping cheekpieces for blinkers this year and, following a win at Chepstow (2m7f, soft), reverted to chasing with clear/close second to unexposed rival here (2m3f, heavy) a fortnight ago; this race is stronger but the move back up in trip will suit; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Thriving 5yo who has won three times on heavy ground here this year; must be considered
runners.name: El Gavilan
runners.spotlight: Thriving 5yo who has won three times on heavy ground here (2m-2m4f) this year; drew nicely clear of the others with another in-form horse when prevailing by a neck over C&D last time and remains unexposed over this trip; must be considered.
